Before you write

Useful context for an initial enquiry.

  • Your full name and preferred email address
  • A short, factual summary of the issue
  • Any hearing, response or transaction deadline
  • The other parties involved, for conflict checking
  • The kind of assistance you are seeking
  • No confidential attachments until requested
